channel.title: Wisconsin Newspaper Association - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Wisconsin Newspaper Association (wnanews.com)

item.title: Village of New Glarus files complaint over EMS records
item.description: The Village of New Glarus is filing a complaint with with the Green County District Attorney for records the New Glarus Area EMS has refused to share with the village.

item.title: Complaint against Clintonville school board president released
item.description: The complaint against Glen Drew Lundt, president of the Clintonville Board of Education -- which resulted in an investigation by an independent counsel and Lundt being censured by the board -- has been released.

item.title: Wisconsin Watch teams with Journal Sentinel to provide Fact Briefs
item.description: Ahead of another pivotal election year, the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel and Wisconsin Watch are teaming up to produce more Fact Briefs, 150-word answers to yes/no questions based on claims made in the info sphere.

item.title: Brandon Wegner joins Iron County Miner
item.description: Brandon Wegner has joined the Iron County Miner in Hurley as a contributor.

item.title: Get creative: Discover National Craft Month!
item.description: There’s no better time to unleash those creative juices and dive into hands-on fun than March, which is National Craft Month!

item.title: Town of Delafield Chairman files open meetings complaint over closed session
item.description: Town of Delafield Chairman Edward Kranick has filed a formal complaint with Waukesha County District Attorney Lesli Boese, alleging the City of Delafield violated Wisconsin’s Open Meetings Law during an Oct. 20, 2025, Common Council meeting.

item.title: Former Daily Cardinal society editor dies
item.description: Former Daily Cardinal student newspaper society editor Judith Temby died on Feb. 21, 2026 at the age of 83 at her Mount Horeb home.

item.title: Port Washington mayor, clerk ordered to testify in records case
item.description: Port Washington Mayor Ted Neitzke and Clerk Susan Westerbeke must give depositions in an open records case filed by a Town of Port Washington resident seeking information about the Vantage Data Centers Lighthouse Campus, Ozaukee County Circuit Judge Adam Gerol has ruled.

item.title: How to avoid contractor scams after storm damage
item.description: Knowing your rights — and slowing down — can protect you after heavy snow, flooding, wind or hail damage, when contractors often go door to door promising quick, low-cost fixes.

item.title: News/Media Alliance, America’s Newspapers announce new partnership to strengthen news industry
item.description: News/Media Alliance and America's Newspapers on March 2, 2026 announced the launch of a new partnership designed to strengthen collaboration across the news publishing industry and provide additional benefits to their members.
